ValidationRule.description: Require Industry, Sub Industry, Status Date and Address if Status is Active.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", ISPICKVAL( Account_Status__c , "Active (Product Live)"), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Education", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Healthcare", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Commercial", RecordType.DeveloperName = "Travel", RecordType.DeveloperName = "B2B",
OR( ISBLANK(ShippingCountry), ISBLANK(ShippingStreet), ISPICKVAL ( Account_Industry__c , ""), ISPICKVAL ( Account_Sub_Industry__c , "") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Following fields are required to set Account to Active: Industry, Sub Industry, Status Date and Shipping Address.
